tokens.h4h_note: ἔδησαν V-AAI-3P en=wrapped. "They wrapped his body in linen." δέω = bind/wrap.
δέδεμαι V-RPI-1S en=am in chains. Perfect pass: "I am bound/chained."
δέδεται V-RPI-3S en=chained. "The word of God is not chained/bound."
ἔκρινεν V-AAI-3S en=pronounced. "God has pronounced judgment for you against her." = judicial verdict/condemnation. Reclassified from decide.
